title: Drag Me Home
overview: Created under the umbrella of the Appalachian Media Institute (AMI), this documentary explores rural drag culture, showcasing performers such as Singleton Garrett and Corabelle Bundy Jolie. It provides an intimate portrait of resilience, self-expression, and chosen families within the drag community. It captures the joys and struggles of finding a sense of belonging in rural areas that are not always accepting of difference.
